**Verdict: PASS** for DG2 round 9 on candidate `sha256:45ebccc0…0066294` (544 files, source `7854770e`). The candidate ID matched at the start and the end of my run.

During the run the repository head moved from `041478cb` to `db8caee`, because the domain and code-security reviewers' evidence was auto-committed. I didn't open those files, and the candidate ID stayed the same.

**F-DG2-340 (Low, REQ-PB-029) is CLOSED_VERIFIED.**
- **My round-8 check, re-run unchanged:** it passes in English and Arabic under both locale settings. The screenshots now show the error message once; in round 8 they showed it twice.
- **New checks on four forms:** the charter, transformation create, organization create and the archive reason dialog. On each, the message appears in exactly one alert and once in the page text, in English (LTR) and Arabic (RTL), and nothing is saved.
- **A genuinely different second message is still shown.** The real server never sends that combination, so for this one check the browser was handed a made-up error response.
- **Field errors stay on their own field.**
- **The other forms FE8 swept** (gate detail, journeys, row actions, admin pages) never show this message in a second place.

**Media-type changes (D-069):**
- **Wrong media types are refused.** An evidence upload in any of 9 wrong media types gets the declared 400 `validation.content_type`. Nothing is stored and no audit row is written; I checked the database directly.
- **Valid binary uploads come back unchanged.** Three revisions were uploaded; each download is identical, and its SHA-256 matches both the database and the `Digest` header.
- **JSON operations refuse wrong media types and write nothing.** Accepted JSON variants still work, and Arabic/emoji text comes back unchanged.

**Full regression, all green in both locale settings:**

| Area | Result |
|---|---|
| Static checks | typecheck, build, lint, openapi:lint (161 operations), no-cdn, format and contrast all pass |
| Unit tests | 7/7 runs, 718 tests each (Node 22 ×3, Node 24 ×3, one under CPU load) |
| Integration | 6/6 runs, 559 tests each, on disposable PostgreSQL |
| My QA suites | 599/599 in each locale setting |
| Product e2e | 64/64 in each locale setting, including Define→G2 and Design→G3 |
| My acceptance journey | 94 and 96 tests, plus 20/20 for the final round-9 spec; `server_encoding UTF8` is in the log |
| Accessibility (axe) | 636 scans, 0 serious or critical violations |
| Gate validators | register, pipeline and reconcile all pass |

**A failure that was my mistake:** my first run of the QA suites had 2 failures. I had included an outdated round-1 test of mine that activates KPIs the old way. It fails the same way on the round-8 candidate, so it isn't a regression. Re-run without it, both locale settings were green; the explanation is logged.

**Observation, not a finding:** for the two operations that take no request body (logout and KPI activation), the error detail reads "Send the request body as application/json." The error code is correct, and the UI shows its own translated text, not this detail.

**Findings:** none new. No Critical, High or mandatory issues are open from my review.

**Residuals, recorded as PASS on the offline surface:**
- D-057, live registry: the offline install from the lockfile passes; the live check timed out with no network.
- D-058, live CI: I inspected the CI configuration; there was no live run.
- D-049, Keycloak: the offline login (OIDC) suite, 33 tests, passes.

This review grants no business approval, and product gate G6 does not imply DG7. My disposable clones and scratch data have been removed.

Files are in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG2/round-9/`:
- qa-verifier.json
- qa-verifier.verifications.json
- qa-verifier.md

Evidence is in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/round-9/`, and my new spec is at `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG2/qa/tests/round-9/e2e/dg2-qa-r9.spec.ts`.
